title: 第7章 一位有诚意的师兄第8章 奖励丰厚
content_zh:
柳衔还在自我解释的时候，楚墨却有一番不同的心情。
兜里有几分闲钱，腰杆都不由自主的挺直了几分，自信的走在去往北涯的路上，准备学几门法术武装自己。
集会里人来人往，热闹非凡，有大量修士支起竹木摊架，兜售丹药符箓、灵植矿石、血骨皮肉...
甚至有不少头顶9级杂兵的修士，直接席地而坐，卖着在异世淘来的宝贝。
楚墨还在不少摊子上，见到了和自己同款的储物袋，两枚法钱一个，一次性买十个还能打九折。
他气定神闲在兜售道法的摊子前站住，弯腰拿起一本黄皮书翻阅，自信满满的问道：“老板，这门弄焰术咋卖的？”
好歹也算小有家底，区区一门小法术，岂不是手到擒来。
“三十三枚法钱，不讲价。”
“这么贵？！”楚墨一秒破功，失声道：“这不就是个小法术吗？”
他望着对面6级的摊主，勉强挤出一抹谄笑：“能不能便宜些？”
“呵，穷鬼，买不起就别乱翻。”摊主不屑地撇嘴。
“！”楚墨笑容僵在脸上，满头黑线。话咋这么伤人呢？
“你手上那是样本，就前两句口诀，翻烂了也没用。”摊主瞧着楚墨翻来翻去的模样，‘好心’提醒道。
楚墨悻悻地放下黄皮书——确实没有弹出【是否学习】的提示。
摊主望着他离去的背影，翻了个白眼。宗门内谁没一两个绝活？真把原本摆在摊子上，他不就成免费送法术的冤大头了？
一炷香后，楚墨停下脚步，集会依旧热闹，他却只觉得吵闹。
连兜里的十枚法钱也不觉得香了。一路问价下来，他发现自己这点家当全砸进去，也就听个响。
而且摊主一个个防贼似的，只摆样本，原本藏的严严实实，根本不给他偷学的机会。
正当楚墨郁闷之际，一位面相大气，身着金纹黑服的摊主朝他招手：“师弟！这边。”
摊主笑眯眯的拉住楚墨衣角，“我看师弟逛了半天，还没找到合心意的？”

楚墨叹了口气，“想弄门法术研究，但没见到钟意的。”
“你早说啊！”摊主猛的一拍手，“找他们干什么？谁不知道北涯集会就我罗山的货最全，价最公道！”
“当真？”楚墨重新燃起希望。
“那必须的。”罗山拍拍胸脯，从储物袋中掏出一卷竹简，“瞧瞧这【离魂砂】怎么样？”
他偷偷打量四周，发现没人注意后，身体前倾离楚墨近了几分，神神秘秘的说道：
“师弟你都炼气二层了，很快要参加外门考核吧？最近两年考核都在蛮荒界，那儿的土著蛮子只修血脉，神魂弱得很！
这离魂砂施展后能吹出一股黑风，专伤神魂。学了它，考核易如反掌，轻松晋升外门弟子。怎么样，心动不？只要三十六枚法钱。”
楚墨接过竹简一看，讶然道：“居然是原本？”
只是法术后面内容模糊不清，看不真切。
“当然是原本，师兄够诚意吧？”罗山大气的说道。后面内容被自己施了独门禁制，所以根本不怕偷学。
“够！够！”楚墨大喜。
[技能【离魂砂】，是否学习？]
content_en:
While Liu Xian was still explaining himself, Chu Mo had a different mood.
With some spare money in his pocket, he straightened his waist involuntarily and walked confidently on the way to Bei Ya, ready to learn a few spells to arm himself.
The gathering was bustling with people coming and going. A large number of monks set up bamboo and wooden stalls, selling elixirs, talismans, spiritual plants ores, blood, bones, skin and flesh...
There were even many monks with level 9 soldiers on their heads, sitting directly on the ground, selling treasures bought in other worlds.
Chu Mo also saw storage bags of the same style as his own at many stalls, with two French coins each. If you buy ten at a time, you can get a 10% discount.
He calmly stopped in front of the stall selling Taoism, bent down and picked up a yellow book to read, and asked confidently: "Boss, how do you sell this pyrotechnic?"
After all, he is considered to have a small fortune, and he can easily master a small magic skill.
"Thirty-three Dharma coins, no bargaining."
"So expensive?!" Chu Mo broke through the power in a second and said in a voiceless voice: "Isn't this just a small spell?"
He looked at the stall owner at Level 6 opposite and forced out a flattering smile: "Can it be cheaper?"
"Oh, you poor man, if you can't afford it, don't go shopping around." The stall owner curled his lips disdainfully.
"!" Chu Mo's smile froze on his face, and his head was covered with black lines. Why are words so hurtful?
"That's a sample in your hand. It's just the first two formulas. It's useless if you turn it over." The stall owner reminded Chu Mo with good intentions as he looked at Chu Mo turning it over.
Chu Mo put down the yellow book angrily—there was indeed no prompt [Whether to study] that popped up.
The stall owner looked at his leaving figure and rolled his eyes. Who in the sect doesn’t have one or two unique skills? If he really put the original on the stall, wouldn't he be the one who gave away the spell for free?
After burning the incense, Chu Mo stopped. The gathering was still lively, but he only felt noisy.
Even the ten dharma coins in my pocket no longer smell good. After asking about the price along the way, he found that all his belongings were thrown in, and he just heard a sound.
Moreover, the stall owners acted like they were on guard against thieves and only displayed samples. They were originally well hidden and did not give him any chance to learn secretly.
Just when Chu Mo was depressed, an imposing-looking stall owner wearing black clothes with gold patterns waved to him: "Junior brother! This way."
The stall owner smiled and grabbed the corner of Chu Mo's clothes, "I think junior brother has been shopping for a long time and hasn't found anything you like?"
Chu Mo sighed, "I want to do some magic research, but I haven't seen Zhong Yi."
"You told me earlier!" The stall owner clapped his hands fiercely, "Why are you looking for them? Who doesn't know that I, Luoshan, have the most complete products at the Beiya Fair and the most reasonable prices!"
"Seriously?" Chu Mo rekindled hope.
"That's necessary." Luo Shan patted his chest and took out a roll of bamboo slips from his storage bag, "How about this [Soul-Leaving Sand]?"
He secretly looked around and found that no one was paying attention. He leaned forward a little closer to Chu Mo and said mysteriously:
"Junior brother, you are already at the second level of Qi Refining. You will take the outer sect exam soon, right? The exams for the past two years have been in the wild world. The indigenous barbarians there only cultivate bloodline, and their souls are very weak!
This soul-living sand can blow out a black wind after being used, which is designed to hurt the soul. After learning it, the assessment will be easy and you will be easily promoted to an outer disciple. How are you? Are you excited? Only thirty-six French coins. "
Chu Mo took the bamboo slip and looked at it, and said in surprise: "It's actually the original one?"
It's just that the content behind the spell is blurry and unclear.
"Of course it was originally, isn't senior brother sincere enough?" Luo Shan said grandly. The following content has been restricted by myself, so I am not afraid of learning from it at all.
"Enough! Enough!" Chu Mo was overjoyed.
[Skill [Soul-Leaving Sand], do you want to learn it? ]
